source_method: District-registered water masks derived from the seam-finished native coast plates. A restrained wet contact line, variable breaker crest, and asymmetric advance/retreat cycle preserve the irregular authored shoreline. Connected-component cleanup retains the coastal foam mass while removing disconnected offshore diamond artifacts.

assembly_contract.registration: Draw the selected phase with the exact coast geography chunk order, world-distance source offset, and 640px playfield width.
rules: Every frame remains a true-alpha 640x1024 overlay; geography is never baked into the animation.
Top and bottom scanlines are fully transparent so all district joins close exactly.
Animation time changes only the held phase; speed changes only integrated world distance and cannot re-phase the coastline.
Runtime modulation remains restrained because the geography plate already contains the darkest static wet-rock and foam foundation.
Disconnected alpha components below 400 pixels are removed before the original soft breaker alpha is reapplied.
